credits.title: My last day in Barcelona
credits.overview: It is Uri's last day in Barcelona and his flatmate Arnau has kicked him out of their house for the afternoon. Without any friends available to hang out, Uri will decide to film the city with an analog camera he finds in his wardrobe, but he receives an unexpected phone call from Arnau.

credits.title: The border
credits.overview: January 1939, Spanish Civil War. Jaume and Miquel, two republican soldiers on their way to exile in France, are intercepted by nationals guarding the border. When Jaume is wounded, the escape plans get complicated.

credits.title: The Termite's Nest
credits.overview: In the solitude of winter, Leon enters for the last time the inhospitable house where he grew up.

credits.title: Sisters
credits.overview: Two sisters bring their families together for a summer weekend near Madrid to celebrate milestones and the San Juan Festival. The celebration turns dark when a child makes a serious sexual abuse allegation.

credits.title: Viva
credits.overview: After coming face to face with death, 40-year-old Nora is consumed by an urgent need to feel alive. She dives into passionate relationships with two very different men, Tom and Max, whose opposing natures reflect her own inner conflict. credits.title: Pizza Movies
credits.overview: In the midst of a professional crisis, a couple decides to leave everything behind and start a new business.

credits.title: Werewolf
credits.overview: Adrià is a boy who lives from village to village with his older brother and his older brother's girlfriend. He is mute, can't stand enclosed spaces, and finds it hard to keep his attention when spoken to. Adrià has a secret: on full moon nights, he can't sleep and wanders the streets.

credits.title: Superlopez
credits.overview: Juan López must balance an office job with heroic feats to save the love of his life and native planet Chitón.
